name: kie-mcp
display_name: KIE.ai — image, video, music, character generation
description: Generate image, music, video using the latest creative models like Seedance, Suno, Kling, GPT and so much more!
long_description: MCP Connector to use Kie AI, an aggregator that allows you to connect to the latest creative models in the market.

kie_api_key.title: KIE.ai API Key
kie_api_key.description: Your Kie AI API key. Get one at https://kie.ai

kie_workspace_dir.title: Workspace folder (optional)
kie_workspace_dir.description: Leave empty to save downloads to the default folder. Set a folder to keep all file reads and writes inside it.

tools.name: kie_post
tools.description: Use to call kie ai to start a new job.

tools.name: kie_get
tools.description: Use to poll for an ongoing job.

tools.name: kie_upload_file
tools.description: Use to upload a local file to kie ai. Returns a hosted URL you can reference in a job.

tools.name: kie_download
tools.description: Use to download a result like a finished image or video to your computer.

tools.name: kie_fetch_model_docs
tools.description: Use to look up how a specific model works before calling it.
